func mapWithConcurrency(
  items: [Int], width: Int, operation: @escaping @Sendable (Int) async -> Void
) async {
  for offset in stride(from: 0, to: items.count, by: width) {
    await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
      for item in items[offset..<min(offset + width, items.count)] {
        group.addTask { await operation(item) }
      }
      await group.waitForAll()
    }
  }
}
